XMLDB.COMMENT: Shared chat engine schema: one thread store for every chat placement.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_chateng_thread
TABLE.COMMENT: One conversation, whichever placement it was started from. Replaces the four per-plugin thread tables (tutor, chat block, aichat, elli): a single schema is the only way the privacy provider, the history limit and the retention task can be written once instead of four times. The row is site-local bookkeeping; a stateful backend additionally owns its own transcript, addressed here through convkey.

FIELD.NAME: placement
FIELD.COMMENT: Frankenstyle component of the placement that owns the conversation, e.g. block_elediaai_tutor or mod_elli. Scopes every read so two placements can never see each other's threads.

FIELD.NAME: instanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The placement's own instance id (block instance, activity instance), or 0 for a site-wide conversation.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context the conversation happens in. Drives the privacy provider's context lookup and Markdown rendering.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the conversation belongs to, or 0 for a site-wide conversation.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning Moodle user, or 0 when the conversation belongs to an unauthenticated visitor identified by guestkey.

FIELD.NAME: guestkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Opaque per-visitor key for guest conversations. Never derived from personal data; the only handle an unauthenticated visitor has on their own thread.

FIELD.NAME: backend
FIELD.COMMENT: Adapter id the thread was created against, matching the sink id in local_elediaai_sources. Recorded because a site that switches destination must not continue a conversation whose transcript lives in the old backend.

FIELD.NAME: convkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Opaque conversation identifier issued by the backend, or null while the backend has not issued one. Never parsed here.

FIELD.NAME: personahash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 over the effective persona. A changed persona starts a new thread rather than continuing one whose earlier turns followed different instructions.

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: Answer mode the thread runs in: grounded or ungrounded.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional display title for a conversation list.

FIELD.NAME: lastpreview
FIELD.COMMENT: Truncated preview of the last user message, for conversation lists. Not a transcript.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Creation timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last-modified timestamp; also the retention clock.

INDEX.NAME: placeinstuser
INDEX.COMMENT: The hot path: resume this user's thread in this placement.

INDEX.NAME: userid
INDEX.COMMENT: Privacy export and erasure by user.

INDEX.NAME: guestkey
INDEX.COMMENT: Resolve a guest visitor's own thread.

INDEX.NAME: contextid
INDEX.COMMENT: Privacy provider context lookups and context deletion.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_chateng_msg
TABLE.COMMENT: Turns of a conversation, oldest first. Held site-side even when the backend keeps its own transcript, so the history limit, the privacy export and the teacher-visible record do not depend on an external service staying reachable.

FIELD.NAME: threadid
FIELD.COMMENT: The conversation this turn belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: role
FIELD.COMMENT: Author role: user, assistant or system.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Message text as Markdown. Stored raw; rendered through the Markdown renderer on output, never trusted as HTML.

FIELD.NAME: sources
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded citations the backend returned for an assistant turn, or null. Kept so a reloaded conversation still shows what it was grounded in.

FIELD.NAME: origin
FIELD.COMMENT: Where an assistant turn came from: grounded, mcp or general. Null for turns recorded before this was stored, and for user turns. Kept alongside the citations because an answer read out of Moodle through the connector carries no citations and would otherwise be indistinguishable from the model talking to itself once the page is reloaded.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the turn was recorded.

INDEX.NAME: threadtime
INDEX.COMMENT: Read a conversation in order, and trim the oldest turns.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_chateng_usage
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user daily message counters for cost governance. Separate from the turns table because the question it answers - how many messages has this person sent today - must stay cheap enough to ask before every turn, and must survive a user clearing their conversations.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The chatting user.

FIELD.NAME: daykey
FIELD.COMMENT: Day as YYYYMMDD in the server timezone.

FIELD.NAME: messagecount
FIELD.COMMENT: Messages sent that day.

KEY.NAME: userday
KEY.COMMENT: One counter row per user per day.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_chateng_design
TABLE.COMMENT: A named chat design: a bundle of design-token values an administrator can point any chat surface at. Kept apart from the placements so one look can be defined once and used by the tutor block, the chat activity and the learning scenario alike - which is the difference between a suite and three plugins that happen to resemble each other.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable name, shown wherever a design is picked.

FIELD.NAME: shortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable machine name, unique; what an export refers to.

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional note describing where the design is meant to be used.

FIELD.NAME: tokens
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON map of design token => value. A token that is absent falls back to the built-in default, so a design only states what it changes.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order in the selection list.
